blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Physics-derived simulation can supplement scarce real-world LiDAR intensity measurements, but its effectiveness depends on the learning architecture and the amount of real training data available. We benchmark nine neural architectures for LiDAR intensity reconstruction from depth, semantic labels, incidence angle, and material reflectance, using real SemanticKITTI and synthetic VoxelScape range-image data. All models follow a fixed 20-epoch protocol; this controls the number of training passes, not the computational cost across architectures. We report mean absolute error (MAE), mean squared error (MSE), peak signal-to-noise ratio (PSNR), structural similarity (SSIM), inference timing, and spectral-energy agreement. We also evaluate four selected architectures with fixed-size training mixtures containing 0\%, 1\%, 5\%, 10\%, 20\%, 50\%, or 100\% real frames. With real-only training, UNet-V2 achieves the best reported reconstruction metrics (MAE 0.234, MSE 0.140, PSNR 8.64 dB, and SSIM 0.647), followed by a denoising diffusion model (DDPM). In several mixtures containing 1--10\% real data, DDPM achieves lower error and higher image-quality metrics than the evaluated deterministic alternatives, whereas UNet-V2 leads with 100\% real data. Spectral analysis additionally reveals architecture-dependent discrepancies across frequency bands. These findings characterize reconstruction trade-offs under the stated data mixtures and fixed-epoch protocol, without establishing compute-matched superiority or isolating the diffusion objective from backbone differences.

blocks.en: Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: LiDAR (light detection and ranging) provides geometric measurements and return-intensity information for robotic perception and autonomous driving 1 , 2 . In addition to range, the recorded return intensity depends on surface properties, incidence angle, distance, and characteristics of the sensing system 3 , 4 . Reproducing realistic intensity is useful for sensor simulation and learning-based processing, but large collections of real measurements and associated scene annotations are costly to assemble. Simulation can supplement real-world observations and enable systematic evaluation of learning systems 5 . However, a model trained on simulated observations may not behave similarly on real measurements because the two domains differ in appearance, noise, scene composition, and sensor response 6 .
blocks.zh: LiDAR(光探测和测距)提供几何测量和回光度信息,用于机器人感知和自主驱动 1, 2 . 除范围外,所记录的回放强度取决于地表属性,事件角度,距离,以及感知系统3,4的特点. 复制出现实的强度对于传感器模拟和基于学习的处理很有用,但大量收集出真实的测量数据和相关场景说明,组装成本高昂. 模拟可以补充现实世界的观察,能够对学习系统进行系统评价 5 (英语). 但是,在模拟观测方面受过训练的模型在实际测量方面可能不会有类似的行为,因为这两个领域在外观、噪音、场景组成和传感器反应6方面各不相同。

blocks.en: Recent physics-aware LiDAR pipelines represent point clouds as organized range images and derive depth (D), semantic-label (L), incidence-angle (I), and material-reflectance (M) modalities 3 , 4 . These DLIM features provide physically motivated inputs for intensity prediction. Prior work studied UNet- and Pix2Pix-based reconstruction using related inputs 4 . An open empirical question is whether the architecture ranking changes when the real-data fraction becomes small and synthetic data comprise most of the training and validation set. This issue is distinct from performance on a fully synthetic test set: deployment-relevant transfer requires testing on held-out real-world measurements.
blocks.zh: 最近的物理学意识LiDAR管道代表了有组织射程图象的点云并衍生出深度(D)、语义-标签(L)、事件角(I)和物质反射(M)模式3、4。 这些DLIM特征为强度预测提供了物理动力输入. 先前的工作利用相关投入研究了基于UNet和Pix2Pix的重建 4。 一个开放的经验问题是,当真实数据分数变得小而合成数据构成大多数培训和验证集时,架构排名是否发生变化. 这个问题不同于完全合成测试集的性能:与部署有关的转移需要测试被搁置的现实世界的测量。

blocks.en: We address this question through a benchmark of nine architectures spanning convolutional encoder–decoders, adversarial models, a vector-quantized autoencoder, a denoising diffusion model, and a flow-matching model. The experiments first measure each architecture on held-out data from the same source as training. We then study four representative architectures on fixed-size mixtures of real SemanticKITTI and synthetic VoxelScape frames, with evaluation on the same held-out SemanticKITTI test set. The mixture sweep is designed to describe sensitivity to real-data availability, rather than to establish a causal advantage of synthetic augmentation over compute-matched real-only training.
blocks.zh: 我们通过9个结构的基准来解决这个问题,这些结构跨越了革命编码器 — — 解码器、对抗模型、矢量化自编码器、去诺化扩散模型和流相匹配模型。 实验首先用与培训相同的来源的搁置数据衡量每个架构。 然后,我们研究关于真实语义KITTI和合成VoxelScape框架的固定尺寸混合物的四种代表性结构,同时对相同的被搁置语义KITTI测试集进行评价。 混合扫描是为了描述对真实数据可用性的敏感性,而不是为了确立合成增强比计算匹配的活性训练的因果优势.

blocks.en: Our contributions are threefold: • We compare nine architectures for DLIM-conditioned LiDAR intensity reconstruction under a common 20-epoch training protocol and report reconstruction and inference metrics on real and synthetic datasets. • We quantify how the performance of four selected architectures changes across real-data fractions from 0% to 100%, using a fixed total mixture size and a common real-domain evaluation set. • We complement image-level metrics with frequency-band spectral-energy analysis to describe differences in the scales of intensity variation represented by the predictions.
blocks.zh: • 我们的贡献有三: 根据共同的20世纪培训协议,我们比较了DLIM条件的LiDAR强度重建的9个架构,并报告关于真实和合成数据集的重建和推断指标。 我们使用固定的混合物总大小和共同的真域评价集,量化四个选定架构的性能在真实数据分数中从0%到100%的变化。 我们用频带光谱能分析来补充图像水平的测量,以描述预测所代表的强度变化尺度的差异.

blocks.en: A fixed epoch count does not equalize GPU time, floating-point operations, optimizer steps for differently sized datasets, or convergence across model families. Accordingly, the results should be interpreted as an architecture comparison under the stated protocol, not as a compute-matched efficiency ranking. Section Related Work reviews the relevant foundations, Section Deep Learning Architectures describes the architectures, Section Results presents the results, Section Discussion and Limitations discusses limitations, and Section Conclusion summarizes the findings.

blocks.en: Related Work
blocks.zh: 相关工作

blocks.en: SemanticKITTI provides real-world LiDAR point clouds and semantic annotations associated with KITTI odometry sequences 2 . VoxelScape provides simulated LiDAR scans and scene annotations 7 . These resources support studies of learning with real and synthetic measurements, but their distributions should not be assumed equivalent. In particular, synthetic-to-real shifts can affect LiDAR perception performance 6 . Our study focuses on regression of LiDAR return intensity rather than semantic segmentation, and evaluates mixed-source models on held-out real data.
blocks.zh: 语义KITTI提供现实世界的LiDAR点云和与 KITTI odometry 序列相关的语义说明 2. VoxelScape 提供模拟的 LiDAR 扫描和场景说明 7 (英语). 这些资源支持用真实和合成测量方法进行学习的研究,但不应假定其分布相等. 特别是合成到现实的转变会影响LiDAR感知性能 6. 我们的研究侧重于LiDAR回归强度的回归而不是语义分解,并评价被搁置的真实数据的混合源模型.

blocks.en: Projecting LiDAR points into structured two-dimensional range images enables the use of image-to-image neural networks 3 , 4 . Previous work combined depth, incidence angle, material reflectance, and semantic information to provide physically motivated features for intensity prediction. In an idealized return model, reflected power depends on range, the orientation of the surface relative to the incoming beam, and material reflectance; practical measured intensity additionally depends on sensor processing and other factors 3 , 4 . The material-related features in this line of work draw on sources including NASA ECOSTRESS 8 . We refer to these inputs as physics-derived modalities , rather than interpreting their use alone as a physics-constrained training objective.
blocks.zh: 将LiDAR点投射到结构化的二维范围图像中,可以使用图像到图像神经网络3,4. 以前的工作结合了深度,出事角度,材料反射,和语义信息,为强度预测提供物理动机特征. 在理想化回放模型中,反射的功率取决于射程,地表相对于入射束的取向,以及物质反射;实际测得的强度还依赖于传感器处理和其他因素3,4. 这项工作与材料有关的特点利用了包括美国航天局ECOSTRSS 8在内的各种来源。 我们把这些投入称为物理学产生的方式,而不是将它们单独解释为物理学限制的培训目标。

blocks.en: UNet-style encoder–decoders support dense spatial regression through multiscale representations and skip connections 9 . Conditional adversarial approaches such as Pix2Pix combine a generator with a discriminator to encourage realistic output structure 10 , 11 . Anand et al. 4 previously studied UNet and Pix2Pix for LiDAR intensity inference with physics-derived modalities, reporting the MSE values reproduced in Table 1 . The present work broadens the architecture set and evaluates data-mixture sensitivity, but the reported performance should not be interpreted as a strictly controlled improvement over the earlier study because configurations and training schedules differ.

blocks.en: The power spectrum describes the distribution of squared Fourier magnitude across spatial frequencies. Low-frequency components generally summarize broad intensity variation, while higher-frequency components capture finer variation and sharp transitions. Spectral diagnostics have been considered in studies of learning dynamics and physical-system reconstruction 12 , 13 , 14 , 15 . Comparing predicted and target spectra can expose differences not visible in aggregate pixel-error metrics. However, spectral-energy agreement alone does not establish spatial alignment because the power spectrum does not retain Fourier phase. We therefore treat frequency-band errors as complementary descriptive diagnostics, not as proof of object-level reconstruction or generalized physical understanding.
blocks.zh: 动力频谱描述了平方傅里叶星等在空间频率上的分布. 低频元件一般概括出广泛的强度变异,而高频元件捕捉更细变异和锐变. 在学习动力学和物理系统重建的研究中考虑了光谱诊断. 12,13,14,15. 对预测和目标光谱进行比较,可以暴露总像素-误差度测量中不明显的差异. 然而,光谱-能协议本身并不能建立空间对接,因为电能谱不能保留傅里叶相. 因此,我们把频带误差视为补充性描述性诊断,而不是物体级重建或普遍物理理解的证明。

blocks.en: We compare nine implementations with roughly similar reported model parameter counts and a shared 20-epoch cap. In addition to MAE and MSE, we report PSNR, SSIM, and inference timing. We then examine mixtures of SemanticKITTI and VoxelScape frames on a fixed held-out real test set. The principal contribution is the observed dependence of performance on model choice and real-data fraction within this specific protocol.
blocks.zh: 我们比较了9项执行情况,与所报告的大致相似的模型参数数和共同的20个时代上限。 除了MAE和MSE之外,我们还报告PSNR,SSIM和推论时间. 然后在固定的预留实测装置上检查SemanticKITTI和VoxelScape帧的混合物。 主要贡献是观察到的表现依赖于该具体协议中的模型选择和活数据分数.

blocks.zh: 深层学习结构

blocks.en: UNet-V1 follows the foundational UNet architecture defined by 9 and applied in the context of LiDAR prediction by 4 . This architecture features three encoder and three decoder levels connected via skip connections and max pooling operations. It utilizes standard convolution blocks composed of 2D convolutions, BatchNorm, ReLU and dropout layers to process spatial representations effectively.
blocks.zh: UNet-V1遵循了由9定义并被应用在LiDAR预测以4. 这个架构的特点是通过跳过连接和最大集合操作连接出三个编码器和三个解码器级别. 它利用由2D分解,BatchNorm,ReLU和退出层组成的标准分解块来有效处理空间表示.

blocks.en: IUNet incorporates Inception-style multibranch convolutions motivated by 18 , 19 and the implementation described by 20 . IUNet consists of three encoders and three decoders that feature specialized inception style multi-branch convolutions, BatchNorm, and GELU activations.
blocks.zh: UNet包含了由18、19和20所描述的Inception风格的多分支演变。 IUNet由3个编码器和3个解码器组成,它们具有专门的初始风格多分支分流,BatchNorm和GELU活化等特征.

blocks.en: M&M is a multi-scale architecture defined by 20 . It consists of three specialized encoders that fuse strided convolutions, max pooling, and average pooling operations. Alongside the encoders, there are three decoders equipped with skip connections that combine transposed convolutions, inception upsampling, and pixel shuffle techniques.
blocks.zh: M&M是一个由20所定义的多尺度架构. 它由3个专门编码器组成,这些编码器可以引信被扭曲的演化、最大集合和平均集合操作。 除了编码器之外,还有3个装有跳过连接的解码器,它们结合了移植的分解,初始上标,和像素洗涤技术.

blocks.en:
DDPM (Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Models), as formalized by 21 , utilizes an
encapsulated backbone architecture referred to here as UNet-V3. This backbone architecture introduced by 14 , features three encoders and three decoders built with Residual Blocks that incorporate both timestep and feature information using 2D convolutions, RMSNorm, and SiLU activations. The diffusion framework uses a forward q-process to add white noise to the target and a training loss to learn the reversed noise process. DDPM uses conditioning and attention with sinusoidal position embedded sampling.
blocks.zh:
DDPM(消除扩散概率模型),由21所正式确定,使用
封装骨干架构在此被称作UNet-V3. 这种由14所推出的骨干架构具有由残余区块所建造的3个编码器和3个解码器的特点,这些区块既包含时间步又包含使用2D分解,RMSNorm,和SiLU活化的特性信息. 扩散框架使用前置q-过程来给目标添加白色噪声并进行训练损失来学习倒转噪声过程. DDPM使用有sinusoidal位置嵌入式取样的调节和注意.

blocks.en: FlwMtch (Flow Matching) utilizes the same UNet-V3 backbone architecture, but replaces the traditional diffusion q-process with an optimal transport flow matching process 22 using σ m ​ i ​ n \sigma_{min} of 1e-4, conditioning, attention, and sinusoidal position embedded sampling. This supplies a different generative training objective while retaining the same reported backbone family. Because UNet-V3 differs from UNet-V2, comparisons between DDPM and UNet-V2 jointly reflect changes in backbone and objective.
blocks.zh: FlwMtch (Flow Matching) 使用相同的UNet-V3主干架构,但使用 1e 4 的 \ m i n\ sigma\\ min} 的 sinusoidal 位置, 调制, 注意, 并嵌入式采样, 以 22 的优化运输流匹配过程取代传统的扩散 q- 进程. 这提供了不同的基因培训目标,同时保留了同一报告的骨干家庭。 由于UNet-V3与UNet-V2不同,DDPM和UNet-V2之间的比较共同反映了骨干和客观的变化.

blocks.en: Results
blocks.zh: 结果

blocks.en: We evaluate intensity reconstruction using real SemanticKITTI (SKITTI) and simulated VoxelScape (VSCAPE) scans represented as organized two-dimensional images. The SemanticKITTI split uses sequences 00–02 for training (4,541, 1,101, and 1,858 frames; 7,500 in total), 2,500 frames from sequence 08 for validation, and sequences 09–10 for testing (1,591 and 909 frames; 2,500 in total). The VoxelScape split contains 7,500 training frames selected from sequences 03–10, 2,500 validation frames selected from sequences 11–13, and 2,500 test frames selected from sequences 14–16. These splits separate the selected sequences across training, validation, and testing.
blocks.zh: 我们使用真实的SemanticKITTI(SKITTI)来评价强度重建,并模拟VoxelScap(VSCAPE)扫描以有组织的二维图像来表示. 语义学KITTI分法使用00-02序列来进行训练(4,541,1,101和1,858帧;共7,500帧),从08序列出2,500帧来进行验证,再用09-10序列来进行测试(1,591和909帧;共2,500帧). VoxelScape分裂包含从03–10序列中选取的7,500个训练帧,从11–13序列中选取的2,500个验证帧,从14–16序列中选取的2,500个测试帧. 这些划分将选定的序列从训练、验证和测试中分开。

blocks.en: Depth, semantic-label, incidence-angle, and material-reflectance (DLIM) representations are derived for each included frame following the physics-based preprocessing described in prior work 3 , 4 . The intensity targets are filtered using the procedure illustrated in Figure 5 ; details and the reported threshold notation are discussed in Appendix A.1. We evaluate MAE, MSE, PSNR (data range 1.0), SSIM (window size 7; data range 1.0; uniform window), and the reported inference-time cost (ICOST). Image-level metrics and the spectral diagnostics address different aspects of reconstruction fidelity.
blocks.zh: 深度、语义标签、事件角和物质反射(DLIM)表示法在前作3、4所描述的基于物理的预处理之后,对每个框架都得出。 强度指标采用图5所说明的程序过滤;附录A.1讨论了细节和报告阈值标记。 我们评价MAE、MSE、PSNR(数据范围为1.0)、SSIM(窗口大小为7;数据范围为1.0;统一窗口)以及报告的推断时间成本。 图像水平的度量衡和光谱诊断涉及重建忠诚的不同方面。

blocks.en: All nine architectures are trained under a common cap of 20 epochs, using the model-specific hyperparameters summarized in Table 2 . This design fixes training passes through each corresponding training set but does not normalize GPU time, floating-point operations, training-step cost, or convergence. Comparisons of computational efficiency are therefore restricted to the separately reported inference timing; even those values depend on the implementation and timing protocol described in Appendix A.2.
blocks.zh: 所有9个建筑都使用表2所总结的模型专用超参数在20个世纪的共同封顶下进行训练. 这种设计修补训练经过了每一组相应的训练,但并没有使GPU时间,浮点操作,训练步骤成本,或趋同等正常化. 因此,计算效率的比较仅限于单独报告的推断时间;即使这些数值也取决于附录A.2所述的执行和时间安排协议。

blocks.en: For mixed-source training, a fixed-size set of 7,500 training frames is constructed from X % X\% real SemanticKITTI and ( 100 − X ) % (100-X)\% synthetic VoxelScape data, for X ∈ { 0 , 1 , 5 , 10 , 20 , 50 , 100 } X\in\{0,1,5,10,20,50,100\} . The corresponding validation mixture contains 2,500 frames, and every mixture is evaluated on the same held-out set of 2,500 real SemanticKITTI frames. Since the real-only comparisons in Appendix A.4 can use fewer total frames than the mixed-source runs, those comparisons do not control the number of example exposures or optimizer updates. We interpret them descriptively rather than as compute-matched demonstrations of synthetic-data benefit. We analyze spectral-energy discrepancies using Equation 3 and the frequency bands described in Appendix A.6 and A.7.
blocks.zh: 对于混合来源培训,从X% 实际语义KITTI和(100-X)% (100-X) 合成 VoxelScape 数据,为X% {0, 1, 5, 10, 20, 50, 100 } X\in 0, 1, 5, 10, 20, 20, 50, 10, 20, 50, 100 \}. 相应的验证混合物包含2,500帧,每个混合物都在同一组2,500个真实的SemanticKITTI帧上进行评估。 由于附录A.4中真实的比较可以使用比混合源运行更少的总帧,这些比较不能控制实例曝光数或优化更新. 我们对它们的解释是描述性的,而不是计算出合成数据的好处。 我们使用方程式3和附录A.6和A.7所描述的频段分析光谱能差异。

blocks.en: Architecture Performance Metrics
blocks.zh: 建筑性能计量

blocks.en: We use mean absolute error (MAE) and mean squared error (MSE) to quantify per-pixel discrepancies, with MSE placing greater weight on large residuals. Peak signal-to-noise ratio (PSNR) transforms squared reconstruction error into a logarithmic scale given the stated image data range. Structural similarity (SSIM) compares local luminance, contrast, and structure. We additionally report inference cost (ICOST), as defined by the measurement convention in Appendix A.2. MAE and MSE are interpreted here as numerical errors on the normalized intensity representation, consistent with the stated unit data range for PSNR and SSIM. The implementation-level normalization and validity-mask conventions are not fully specified in the current manuscript. Finally, spectral-energy plots provide complementary information about the relative power of spatial-frequency components, but do not measure whether predicted objects occupy the correct pixel locations.
blocks.zh: 我们使用平均绝对误差(MAE)和平均平方误差(MSE)来量化每个像素的差异,而MSE则加大了对大型残基的权重. 峰值信号对噪比 (PSNR) 将平方重建出错转换成对数尺度,以表示图像数据范围. 结构相似性(SSIM)比较了局部亮度,对比度和结构. 我们还报告附录A.2中的计量公约所定义的推断费用。 MAE和MSE在此被解释为对常态强度表示值的数值错误,与PSNR和SSIM的已声明单位数据范围一致. 目前手稿中没有充分说明执行层面的正常化和有效性任务公约。 最后,光谱能地块提供了空间-频率元件相对功率的补充信息,但不衡量所预测的物体是否占据了正确的像素位置.

blocks.en: Figure 1: SKiTTI performance metrics.
blocks.zh: 图1:SKITTI性能衡量标准。

blocks.en: Figure 1 summarizes the results for models trained and evaluated on SemanticKITTI; exact values appear in Table 3 . UNet-V2 achieves the best reported performance on all four reconstruction metrics: MAE 0.234, MSE 0.140, PSNR 8.64 dB, and SSIM 0.647. DDPM ranks next on the same metrics (MAE 0.241, MSE 0.152, PSNR 8.28 dB, and SSIM 0.633). VQ-VAE2, Pix2Pix, flow matching, and M&M have larger errors or lower structural-similarity scores under the 20-epoch protocol. These outcomes establish relative performance at the chosen training endpoint; they do not by themselves identify whether particular models are limited by architecture, optimization, or convergence.
blocks.zh: 图1汇总了在语义KITTI上培训和评价的模型的结果;确切数值见表3。 UNet-V2在所有四个重建度量标准上都取得了最佳的上报性能:MAE 0.234,MSE 0140,PSNR 8.64 dB,和SSIM 0.647. DDPM在同一度量衡(MAE 0.241,MSE 0.152,PSNR 8.28 dB,和SSIM 0.633)上排名第二. VQ-VAE2,Pix2Pix,流量匹配,和M&M在20世纪协议下存在较大的出错或更低的结构等同分分. 这些成果确定了选定培训终点的相对业绩;它们本身并不确定特定模式是否受到架构、优化或趋同的限制。

blocks.en: Panel (e) compares the target and predicted intensity power spectra. Some architectures display substantially lower spectral power than the target at portions of the frequency range, while others retain comparatively greater power. Both deviations can coexist with poor image-level reconstruction. As phase information is not shown, the spectra should be interpreted as measurements of frequency-dependent energy alignment rather than direct evidence of spatial or semantic fidelity.
blocks.zh: (e) 将目标与预测强度光谱进行比较。 一些架构显示的光谱功率大大低于频率范围部分的目标,而另一些架构则保留了相对较强的功率. 两种偏差都可以与不良的图像级重建并存. 由于相位信息没有显示,光谱应当被解释为对频率依赖能配比的测量,而不是空间或语义忠诚的直接证据.

blocks.en: Figure 2: VSCAPE performance metrics.
blocks.zh: 图2:VSCAPE业绩衡量标准。

blocks.en: Figure 2 shows the corresponding results for models trained and evaluated on VoxelScape, again using separate held-out sequences from that source. UNet-V2 obtains the lowest reported MSE (0.108), highest PSNR (9.75 dB), and highest SSIM (0.568), with MAE 0.218. IUNet (MAE 0.219, MSE 0.110, PSNR 9.66 dB, SSIM 0.557) and DDPM (MAE 0.220, MSE 0.113, PSNR 9.56 dB, SSIM 0.559) are close competitors; M&M also performs better on VoxelScape than in the separate SemanticKITTI experiment. Pix2Pix has the largest VoxelScape MAE and MSE and the lowest SSIM among the reported models. The differences between the two datasets are consistent with architecture-dependent sensitivity to the evaluation domain, but because these are separate within-domain training-and-testing experiments, they should not themselves be interpreted as direct measurements of synthetic-to-real transfer.
blocks.zh: 图2显示了在VoxelScape上训练和评价的模型的相应结果,再次使用了该来源中分开的搁置序列。 UNet-V2获得的报告最低的MSE (0.108),最高的PSNR (9.75 dB),最高的SSIM (0.568),有MAE 0.218. IUNet(MAE 0.219,MSE 0.110,PSNR 9.66 dB,SSIM 0.557)和DDPM(MAE 0.220,MSE 0.113,PSNR 9.56 dB,SSIM 0.559)是相近的竞争对手;M&M在VoxelScape上的表现也优于单独的SemanticKITTI实验. Pix2Pix拥有最大的VoxelScape MAE和MSE,在所报道的模型中最低的SSIM. 这两个数据集之间的差异与架构依赖性对评价领域的敏感度是一致的,但由于这些是单独的域内培训和测试实验,它们本身不应被解释为直接测量合成到真实的转移.

blocks.en: Synthetic Blending Architecture Performance
blocks.zh: 合成混合结构性能

blocks.en: We next study the effect of the real-data fraction within fixed-size training mixtures. Each model receives 7,500 training frames in total and is evaluated on the same held-out 2,500-frame SemanticKITTI test set. The real fractions are X ∈ { 0 , 1 , 5 , 10 , 20 , 50 , 100 } % X\in\{0,1,5,10,20,50,100\}\% . For example, the 1% mixture uses 75 real and 7,425 synthetic training frames, while the 100% mixture uses 7,500 real frames. The matching validation mixtures contain 2,500 frames. The real and synthetic subsets for a given fraction are shared across the evaluated architectures, according to the experimental setup.
blocks.zh: 我们接下来研究 固定尺寸的训练混合物中 真实数据分数的影响。 每个模型总共接受7 500个培训框架,并在同一被搁置的2 500个框架的SemanticKITTI测试中进行评价。 真实分数为X {0, 1, 5, 10, 20, 50, 100}% {in}0, 1, 5, 10, 20, 50, 100} . 例如,1%的混合物使用75个正版和7,425个合成训练框架,而100%的混合物使用7,500个正版框架. 相匹配的验证混合物包含2500帧. 特定分数的真和合成子集根据实验设置在被评价的架构中共享.

blocks.en: Four representative models are studied in detail: UNet-V2 and DDPM, which obtain the strongest performance on the fully real-data comparison, together with IUNet and M&M, which exhibit comparatively large changes between real-trained and synthetic-trained evaluations in Appendix A.3. A large relative change denotes sensitivity to the training domain and does not necessarily denote a favorable transfer outcome. The mixture experiment measures how the selected models respond to different training compositions at a constant total mixture size; it does not isolate the impact of synthetic data from potential interactions with the available real examples.
blocks.zh: 详细研究了四个具有代表性的模式:UNet-V2和DDPM,它们与IUNet和M&M一起,在完全真实数据比较上获得了最强的性能,在附录A.3中,在经过实际培训的评价和经过合成培训的评价之间显示出了相对较大的变化。 一个较大的相对变化表示对培训领域的敏感性,并不一定表示有利的转让结果。 混合物实验测量选定模型如何在不断的混合物总尺寸下对不同的训练成分作出反应;它不会将合成数据的影响从可能与现有真实例子的相互作用中分离出来。

blocks.en: Figure 3: SKITTI blending performance.
blocks.zh: 图3 SKITTI混合性能.

blocks.en: Figure 3 reports reconstruction metrics across the selected mixtures. At 0% real data, all four architectures exhibit comparatively poor performance on the real test set, illustrating the difficulty of direct synthetic-only transfer under the present setup. The inclusion of a small fraction of real training frames is associated with a marked improvement for every model. Across several mixtures with 1–10% real data, DDPM has the lowest reported MAE and among the strongest MSE and PSNR values. Its SSIM exceeds those of the other selected architectures at the intermediate mixtures shown, but not at the 100% real-data endpoint: there UNet-V2 achieves SSIM 0.647 compared with DDPM’s 0.633. As the real-data fraction increases, UNet-V2 becomes increasingly competitive and achieves the best reported MAE, MSE, PSNR, and SSIM under 100% real-data training.
blocks.zh: 图3报告选定混合物的重建指标。 以0%的真实数据,所有四个架构在真实测试集上表现出相对较差的性能,说明了在当前设置下直接合成-只进行转移的难度. 列入一小部分真正的培训框架与每个模式的显著改进有关。 在若干有1-10%真实数据的混合物中,DDPM的MAE报告值最低,在MSE和PSNR数值中也最低。 它的SSIM超过了所显示的中间混合物上的其他所选结构,但并非100%的真数据端点:在那里,UNet-V2实现了SSIM 0.647,而DDPM的0.633。 随着真实数据分数的增加,UNet-V2的竞争力日益提高,在100%的真实数据培训下,实现了最佳的MAE,MSE,PSNR和SSIM.

blocks.en: IUNet and M&M show different responses to composition and have relatively competitive synthetic-only results among the selected models on some metrics. Nonetheless, their absolute reconstruction metrics generally improve as real-data availability increases. The key result is thus a change in relative architectural ranking across mixture ratios, not an absolute deterioration of these models when real frames are introduced. Because the study contains only selected architectures in the mixture sweep, the findings are limited to that subset.
blocks.zh: IUNet和M&M对组成有不同的反应,在一些计量标准上的某些模型中具有相对竞争性的仅合成结果. 然而,随着实际数据提供量的增加,其绝对重建指标普遍得到改进。 因此,关键结果是不同混合物比率的相对建筑排名发生变化,而不是在采用实际框架时这些模型的绝对恶化。 由于该研究只包含混合扫描中的某些架构,结果仅限于该子集.

blocks.en: Figure 4: SKITTI blending ablations.
blocks.zh: 图4:SKITTI混合活泼.

blocks.en: Figure 4 provides supplementary comparisons of blended and real-only training, SSIM variation, and spectral-energy agreement; fuller plots appear in Appendix A.4–A.7. Panel (a) shows that the gap between blended and real-only PSNR differs between UNet-V2 and DDPM, particularly at the 1% real-data level. This is an informative descriptive result, but the real-only run at 1% uses only 75 training frames, whereas the blended run uses 75 real plus 7,425 synthetic frames. Under the same 20-epoch cap, the total number of examples processed differs substantially, so the observed gap cannot be attributed solely to synthetic-data information. Panel (b), based on three random seeds for UNet-V2 and DDPM, indicates that the reported SSIM means and variability also depend on mixture proportion. With only three seeds, these intervals should be viewed as preliminary rather than conclusive evidence of ranking stability.
blocks.zh: 图4提供了混合培训与唯一培训、SSIM变异和光谱能协议的补充比较;更完整的地块载于附录A.4-A.7。 小组(a) 显示,UNet-V2和DDPM之间混合培训和唯一PSNR之间的差距不同,特别是在1%的实数据层面。 这是一种信息性描述性的结果,但以1%的速度进行的实际只使用75个培训框架,而混合运行则使用75个真实加7 425个合成框架。 在同一20个时代的上限下,所处理的例子总数相差很大,因此所观察到的差距不能完全归因于合成数据信息. 小组(b)基于UNet-V2和DDPM的三个随机种子,表明所报告的SSIM手段和可变性也取决于混合物比例。 只有三种种子,这些间隔应被看作是排名稳定的初步而非确凿证据。

blocks.en: Panels (c)–(e) examine spectral-energy errors. DDPM frequently exhibits smaller mid-frequency errors, whereas M&M achieves comparatively small low-frequency errors for several mixtures. The ranking is not uniform in every band and mixture: for example, Figure 4 (e) reports a lower high-frequency error for IUNet than for DDPM at 50% real data. Accordingly, the evidence supports architecture-dependent frequency-band alignment rather than universal dominance of one model at all spatial scales. Moreover, similarity of Fourier magnitudes does not guarantee reconstruction of the correct object positions or boundaries.
blocks.zh: (c)-(e)小组审查光谱能差错。 DDPM经常显示较小的中频出错,而M&M对几种混合物的低频出错相对较小. 排名在每一个波段和混合物中并不一致:例如,图4(e)报告IUNet的高频出错率低于DDPM的50%真实数据. 因此,证据支持依赖结构的频率带调整,而不是在所有空间尺度上一个模型的普遍主导。 此外,Fourier等分的相似性并不能保证重建正确的物体位置或边界。

blocks.en: Discussion and Limitations
blocks.zh: 讨论和限制

blocks.en: The joint results suggest a regime-dependent choice between architectures. UNet-V2 is a strong direct-regression baseline when all 7,500 real training frames are available, and its reported inference cost is lower than DDPM’s. DDPM, by contrast, is competitive at several low real-data mixture fractions. This finding may motivate generative modeling in data-scarce scenarios, but the experiments do not establish that the diffusion learning objective is the sole source of the advantage. The DDPM implementation uses the UNet-V3 backbone, whereas UNet-V2 differs in residual structure, normalization, activation, and conditioning; backbone and objective effects are therefore confounded.
blocks.zh: 联合结果表明,在结构之间要作出取决于制度的选择。 UNet-V2是所有7 500个真正培训框架都可用时的强有力的直接退后基线,其报告的推论成本也低于DDPM。 相形之下,DDPM在几个低实相数据混合物分量上具有竞争力. 这一发现可能激发了数据稀缺情景中的基因模型,但实验并未确定扩散学习目标是优势的唯一来源. DDPM的执行使用UNet-V3主干线,而UNet-V2则在剩余结构,正常化,活化和调节方面有差异;因此,主干和客观效果令人困惑.

blocks.en: The results also distinguish within-domain reconstruction from transfer to real data. The models perform more strongly when trained and tested within the VoxelScape domain than when synthetic-only training is followed by evaluation on SemanticKITTI. Introducing a small number of real training examples is associated with large improvements in the latter setting. The reported curves characterize this behavior for the available sequences and mixture construction; they do not identify the specific dataset characteristics responsible for the domain difference. Similarly, DLIM inputs are physics-derived features, but none of the benchmarked objectives is shown here to enforce a LiDAR return equation or a physical constraint.
blocks.zh: 结果还将域内重建从传输到真实数据区分开来. 在VoxelScape域内接受培训和测试时,这些模型的性能比仅接受合成培训后对SemanticKITTI进行评价时要强。 引进少数真正的培训实例与后一种环境的巨大改善有关。 所报告曲线为可用序列和混合物构造定性了这种行为;它们没有识别导致域差的具体数据集特征. 同样地,DLIM输入是物理学衍生的特征,但这里没有显示任何基准目标来强制执行LiDAR回方程或物理约束.

blocks.en: The benchmark has several limitations. First, the common 20-epoch cap is not a matched computational budget and may leave different architectures at different points in their optimization trajectories. Second, the blending study varies data composition at a fixed total of 7,500 training frames, while the real-only comparisons use smaller datasets at low real-data fractions; those settings differ in example exposure and potentially in update count. Third, the generative architectures are not compared against direct regression using the identical UNet-V3 backbone, preventing attribution of their performance differences solely to diffusion or flow-matching objectives. Fourth, the main evaluation uses a single real-world dataset with selected held-out sequences and a limited set of reported random seeds, which restricts conclusions about sensor-independent and statistically robust generalization.
blocks.zh: 基准有若干限制。 首先,共同的20世纪封顶不是相匹配的计算预算,可能在其优化轨迹的不同点留下不同的架构. 第二,混合研究在固定的总共7,500个培训框架上,数据构成各有不同,而只进行实际比较时,在实际数据分数较低时,使用较小的数据集;这些环境在实例曝光方面有所不同,在更新计算方面可能有所不同。 第三,使用相同的UNet-V3主干线,不将基因结构与直接回归相比较,防止将其性能差异完全归因于扩散或流量匹配目标。 第四,主要评价采用一个具有所选被搁置序列的单一现实世界数据集和有限的一组被报道的随机种子,这限制了关于传感器独立和统计学强通的结论.

blocks.en: Two additional interpretation limits concern the observables. The reported spectral-energy comparison discards phase and cannot establish spatial correctness on its own. Also, the experiments depend on DLIM features, including semantic and material-related information that may not be available without additional processing in deployment. Finally, the current tables report timing under an implementation-specific ICOST definition; without a fully specified timing protocol, they should not be treated as universal latency benchmarks.
blocks.zh: 两个额外的解释限制涉及可观察者。 所报告的光谱能比较会丢弃相位,无法自行确定空间正确性. 此外,这些实验还依赖于DLIM的特征,包括语义和与材料有关的信息,如果不在部署中进行额外处理,这些信息可能无法获得。 最后,目前的表格根据具体执行的ICOST定义报告时间安排;没有明确规定的时间安排议定书,不应将其作为普遍延迟基准。

blocks.en: Conclusion
blocks.zh: 结论

blocks.en: We benchmarked nine architectures for LiDAR intensity reconstruction from physics-derived depth, semantic-label, incidence-angle, and material-reflectance inputs using real SemanticKITTI and simulated VoxelScape data. Under the common 20-epoch training protocol, UNet-V2 achieves the strongest reported reconstruction metrics on the fully real-data comparison (MAE 0.234, MSE 0.140, PSNR 8.64 dB, SSIM 0.647), with DDPM the closest competitor (MAE 0.241, MSE 0.152, PSNR 8.28 dB, SSIM 0.633). IUNet and M&M are relatively more competitive in the separate VoxelScape evaluation than in the fully real-data evaluation, highlighting that within-domain rankings depend on the source distribution.
blocks.zh: 我们利用真实的语义KITTI和模拟的VoxelScape数据,对来自物理学的深度、语义标签、事件角和物质反射输入的9个结构进行了LiDAR强度重建。 根据共同的"20世纪"训练协议,UNet-V2在完全真实数据比较上实现了最强的所报重建度量衡(MAE 0.234,MSE 0140,PSNR 8.64 dB,SSIM 0.647),DDPM为最接近的竞争对手(MAE 0.241,MSE 0.152,PSNR 8.28 dB,SSIM 0.633)。 IUNet和M&M在单独的VoxelScape评价中比在完全真实数据评价中竞争相对较强,强调域内排名取决于出自分布.

blocks.en: In the mixed-source experiments, the evaluated models respond differently to the real-data fraction. DDPM performs strongly in several configurations with 1–10% real training data, while UNet-V2 leads at 100% real data. The accompanying spectral-energy diagnostics expose different patterns of frequency-band agreement, which supplement but do not replace pixel- and structure-based fidelity metrics. Taken together, the results provide a descriptive benchmark of architecture choice under fixed-epoch training and changing real/synthetic composition. They do not establish matched-compute superiority, causal benefits of synthetic augmentation over real-only training, or a uniquely diffusion-driven mechanism. These distinctions are important for selecting models and for designing subsequent controlled studies of data-efficient LiDAR intensity prediction.
blocks.zh: 在混合源实验中,被评价的模型对真数据分数的反应不同. DDPM在几个配置中表现强劲,真实的培训数据为1-10%,而UNet-V2则以100%的真实数据领先. 相伴随的光谱能诊断揭示出频率波段协议的不同模式,这些模式补充但不取代以像素和结构为基础的忠诚度测量. 总而言之,这些成果为固定时间培训和改变真实/合成构成下的建筑选择提供了一个描述性基准。 它们并不确立相匹配的计算优势、合成增强相对于实际培训的因果效益,或一种独特的扩散驱动机制。 这些区别对于选择模型和设计随后对数据效率高的LiDAR强度预测进行受控研究十分重要.

blocks.en: The authors inspected filtered VoxelScape intensity images to select a target-preprocessing threshold. Figure 5 displays one scene (14_xyz_iom_000820) at several reported filtering settings. In the example, the weaker filtering settings preserve visible objects and road markings, whereas stronger filtering progressively suppresses these features. The source description specifies the selected filtering threshold using the literal notation 10e-5 , which is retained here to avoid silently changing the documented configuration. The precise numerical interpretation and mathematical definition of the preprocessing operation are not fully specified by the existing description. Visual inspection of one or more scenes motivates the preprocessing choice but does not by itself establish that the resulting targets preserve all physically meaningful weak returns.
blocks.zh: 作者检查了过滤过的VoxelScape强度图像,以选择目标预处理阈值. 图5显示一个场景(14_xyz_iom_000820)在一些已报告的过滤设置上. 例如,较弱的过滤设置保留了可见物体和道路标识,而较强的过滤逐渐压制了这些特征. 源描述使用字面注解 10e-5来指定所选过滤阈值,此处保留该阈值以避免默默地更改所记录的配置. 对预处理操作的精确数值解释和数学定义没有被现有的描述充分规定. 对一个或多个场景的可视化检查激发了预处理的选择,但本身并不确定由此产生的目标保留了所有具有物理意义的微弱回报.

blocks.en: Mixed-Source versus Real-Only Training
blocks.zh: 混合来源与 仅进行实际培训

blocks.en: Figure 8 compares the selected mixed-source settings with real-only training for UNet-V2 and DDPM. At 1% real data, each blend contains 75 real training frames plus 7,425 synthetic frames and a corresponding 25 real validation frames within the 2,500-frame validation mixture. The real-only comparator uses the same available 75 real training frames without the additional synthetic frames. Consequently, the two conditions do not have the same total number of examples or example exposures under a 20-epoch cap. Differences in MAE, MSE, PSNR, and SSIM are shown for completeness, but cannot be attributed solely to the synthetic data without a matched-update control.
blocks.zh: 图8将所选的混合源设置与UNet-V2和DDPM的实训进行比较. 在1%的真实数据中,每个混合物包含75个真正的训练框架外加7,425个合成框架和2,500个框架的验证混合物内相应的25个真正的验证框架. 唯一真实的参照系统使用同样的75个可用的真实训练帧,而不需要额外的合成帧. 因此,在20个世纪的上限下,这两个条件的例或例接触总量并不相同。 MAE,MSE,PSNR,和SSIM中的差异被显示为完整性,但不能在没有匹配控制的情况下仅仅归为合成数据.
